prompt: Users upload a photo of their fridge and ask the chat model what they could cook.
why: A multimodal model takes the image and the question in one prompt and reasons over both.
trap: Image analysis would only caption or tag it; it can't answer the question.

prompt: A kiosk lets visitors ask questions out loud, and a single deployed model listens and answers directly.
tells: a single deployed model listens and answers
why: A multimodal model can take spoken prompts directly.
trap: Speech to text then a chat model is two steps; the scenario says one model.

prompt: An analyst pastes a screenshot of a sales chart into chat and asks why March dipped.
tells: pastes a screenshot of a sales chart
why: Interpreting visual input inside a prompt is a multimodal model's job.
trap: OCR would read the labels but not interpret the chart.

prompt: An insurer wants a deployed model to look at car-damage photos alongside the claim text and say whether they match.
tells: car-damage photos alongside the claim text
why: Combining image and text in one prompt is multimodal.
trap: Object detection finds dents; judging consistency with text needs the multimodal model.
